title: Separate SoulFactory/OpenClaw control relays from ngit publication relays
observed_behavior_before: WorkspaceManager accepted OpenClawRelays and NgitRelays but initialized ngitRelays from NgitRelays falling back to OpenClawRelays.
pushWithNgit passed only m.ngitRelays[0] to ngit init.
Installed ngit 2.4.2 reports ngit init --relay <RELAY>... support.
intended_behavior: OpenClawRelays are agent runtime/control relays written into generated OpenClaw workspace config.
NgitRelays are NIP-34 repository publication relays required separately when workspace publication runs.
All configured NgitRelays are supplied to ngit init using repeated --relay arguments.
out_of_scope: Backend relay policy sources in internal/config and internal/adapters/nostr.
Backend NIP-51 projection, browser discovery, CLI fallback, and NIP-86.
